summary: The midmorning recovery failed: the S&P is back near -0.7% and the Nasdaq about -1.1% as the 10-year hits 4.96% after hot CPI and Nvidia slides about 6%. Changes: SPY and QQQ flipped from calls to puts after breaking their breakdown levels, NVDA levels lowered, AMD and TTWO confidence cut; quote pages were blocked, so most prices are estimates from search snippets.

picks.name: Nvidia
picks.reason: Down about 6% on day two of the board probe into Huang plus a new class-action suit; Monday's 170.24 low is now resistance and losing 166 opens the 164.27 52-week low.

picks.name: SPDR S&P 500 ETF
picks.reason: The midmorning bounce failed and the S&P is back near -0.7% (about 7,496) with the 10-year at 4.96% after hot CPI; under 745 extends the fade (SPY price estimated from the index).

picks.name: Invesco QQQ Trust
picks.reason: Nasdaq rolled over to about -1.1% as Nvidia sank and rate-hike bets rose; under 667.50 targets the 662 area (price estimated).

picks.name: Rocket Lab
picks.reason: Wider Q3 loss and Neutron slipping to 2027; a break of Monday's 53.01 low extends the selloff in a risk-off tape (no fresh quote, price estimated).

picks.name: Advanced Micro Devices
picks.reason: Still green on rotation out of Nvidia but pared gains at midday with the market; reclaiming 528 resumes the trend, under 514 heads for Monday's close (price estimated).

picks.name: Take-Two Interactive
picks.reason: Holding its post-earnings gap on GTA VI preorders ahead of the Nov 19 launch, but the weak tape caps it; over 219.50 extends (no fresh quote, price estimated).
